propositions: ADR 0098 must be drafted as documentation-only, recording the approved RP-04 decision on operation-scoped immutable configuration and separately-owned provider authentication/runtime bindings without starting implementation.

Every external dependency and OSS behavior claim in ADR 0098 must cite specific primary research sources or Rebar probe artifacts; all claims about AWS, Pydantic, provider clients, subprocess inheritance, and Jira integration must be traceable to completed research.

ADR 0098 must narrow ADR 0049 only at the per-job retrieval/composition seam while explicitly preserving its protocol, trust roots, producer, and storage decisions; relationships to ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0050, 0059, and 0083 must remain consistent and non-superseding.

The numbered Draft Critique for ADR 0098 must resolve all uncited claims, internal inconsistencies, missing constraints, and conflicts with existing ADRs before proceeding to maintainer approval and merge.
